<!-- Generated by contracts/script/address-book/address-book.ts from each network's deployment output; see address-book/README.md. Do not edit by hand. -->

Each chain has one Avana Hub on Aave V4, with a Lend Spoke and the CDP Spokes where AMM liquidity positions are collateral. Each release also records its addresses in its release manifest.

Market pools and risk values are on [Market Parameters](/developers/reference/parameters); roles and who can change what are on [Access Control](/developers/reference/access-controls).

Every Avana chain runs the standard, unmodified Aave V4 release pinned at commit `a3ef63ea6415d25237a9775bf66e76e9993561c2`, and Avana's timelock and upgradeable contracts use OpenZeppelin Contracts and Contracts Upgradeable v5.1.0, pinned by commit. The libraries LPPriceMath, SettlementMath and AvanaRoles are compiled into the contracts that use them and have no address of their own.

- chainId: 11155111
- explorer: https://sepolia.etherscan.io

| Name | Description | Address |

> Each Spoke has its own AaveOracle, created with the Spoke; read its address from the Spoke's `ORACLE()`. Each vault-token reserve also names the Aave treasury Spoke as its fee receiver, with add and draw caps of 0, so it never holds vault tokens.

### Markets

Each market has its own vault token, the ERC-20 a pledge mints and the Spoke holds as collateral, and its own LPOracle proxy, which prices the vault token for the Spoke's AaveOracle. Vault tokens are immutable; each LPOracle is upgradeable through the AvanaTimelock.

### Markets

Each market has its own vault token, the ERC-20 a pledge mints and the Spoke holds as collateral, and its own LPOracle proxy, which prices the vault token for the Spoke's AaveOracle. Vault tokens are immutable; each LPOracle is upgradeable through the AvanaTimelock.

## Local Ethereum development chain
- network: local-ethereum
- chainId: 31337

One Hub with the Lend Spoke and 6 CDP Spokes listing 10 markets. Market pools and risk parameters are on [Market Parameters](/developers/reference/parameters?network=local-ethereum).

A local development chain (chain ID 31337) that the local stack deploys from scratch; its addresses change with each new deployment. Generated from release `v0.1.0-local` (commit `bfbe960b`) and its deploy output.

Each market has its own vault token, the ERC-20 a pledge mints and the Spoke holds as collateral, and its own LPOracle proxy, which prices the vault token for the Spoke's AaveOracle. Vault tokens are immutable; each LPOracle is upgradeable through the AvanaTimelock.

## Local Base development chain
- network: local-base
- chainId: 31338

One Hub with the Lend Spoke and 3 CDP Spokes listing 12 markets. Market pools and risk parameters are on [Market Parameters](/developers/reference/parameters?network=local-base).

A local development chain (chain ID 31338) that the local stack deploys from scratch; its addresses change with each new deployment. Generated from release `v0.1.0-local` (commit `4904404e`) and its deploy output.

### Hub

| Name | Description | Address |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Avana Base Hub | Standard Aave V4 Hub, the only Avana Hub on this chain. It holds the lent assets and the vault-token collateral of every Spoke below, and each Spoke sets its own risk parameters. Upgradeable by the Aave DAO, which owns its proxy. | 0x32Ad27c23fa22c55E5922802a1B561138BBa1511 |

| Aero Slipstream Gov-DeFi | Aave V4 CDP Spoke where Aero Slipstream positions in governance and DeFi token pools are collateral for borrowing GHO and USDC. ### Lend Spoke

| Name | Description | Address |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Lend Spoke | Supply-only Aave V4 Spoke where lenders supply GHO, USDC and USDT for Avana borrowers to draw through the CDP Spokes. Upgradeable by the Aave DAO, which owns its proxy. | 0x902772Cf90360757147988eb21f9B7EC45caDAB4 |

> Each Spoke has its own AaveOracle, created with the Spoke; read its address from the Spoke's `ORACLE()`. Each vault-token reserve also names the Aave treasury Spoke as its fee receiver, with add and draw caps of 0, so it never holds vault tokens.

### Periphery

| Name | Description | Address |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Lens | The read-only contract apps, keepers and monitoring call for account, market, price, risk and liquidation state in one call. No Avana contract depends on it. Immutable; replaced by a new deployment. | 0xe04c94e8DB7610865a3c131ac5350dFb68d28e30 |
| Aero Slipstream integration (LPVault) | Holds every unstaked Aero Slipstream position pledged on this chain, across the four factory generations, and unwinds it on exit or liquidation. Immutable, with no owner. | 0x41a1103DAfB07B10EbBed633BCf3c0D3bCFB7853 |
| AaveV3FlashSource | Lends LPVaultSwap the debt asset from the Aave V3 Pool for one call so a borrower can repay with collateral. Immutable; the AvanaTimelock can replace it. | 0x6f04e1eb7aC13CC39f84339c88d8a5363595FEd3 |
| FlashLiquidator | Public flash liquidation helper: anyone can liquidate an account without holding the debt asset. Immutable. | 0xD5444E7b0F82eC24d0A837d4EC79Cc19f1Cf50cb |
| OperatorFlashLiquidator | Avana's keeper's own flash liquidation helper; only its signer can call it. Immutable. | 0x84152212ee0f850fC9448A0d097976DE1EaedB27 |
| AvanaGasVault | Holds the chain's native gas token and refills Avana's own keeper signers up to a per-signer cap over any 24 hours. Immutable. | Not deployed on this network |

#### Lens modules (called only through Lens)

The Lens forwards each view to one of these read-only contracts. Call the Lens, not these.

| Name | Description | Address |
| --- | --- | --- |
| LensAccountModule | Account views and close-account sizing. Immutable. | 0x9C2930918FE7BaC108fe369bF20dCa437636B461 |
| LensMarketModule | Views of one market. Immutable. | 0x54D595704D8113Cb438f8114d92ADb02EE99eaCA |
| LensPriceModule | Price, debt-price and pause-state views and deleverage sizing. Immutable. | 0xC0959F95f4ca85c9D9759cF7A7A8bD4AC569670D |
| LensLiquidationModule | Liquidation preview. Immutable. | 0x5d28FaD82897e0252F2582f5a1F1307E227665f9 |
| LensRiskModule | Risk and Hub-asset views. Immutable. | 0xdEab46f32eAAcd2fa999dC60d980cDEfd5A7aFBe |
| LensPreviewModule | Action previews. Immutable. | 0x7ed0fA18A3191103F5E324Ca6395a46d4EF931D1 |
| LensMarketsModule | Market list and fee views. Immutable. | 0x3dC30ffAF411ac6b65b8bd8d17B5da8D6b7Ab2C8 |
| LensPositionsModule | Position views, available actions and maximum-withdraw sizing. Immutable. | 0x73e2e11B6128dBcAE8d57176FaC5f0cFcfc9e401 |
| LensSpeedModule | Speed-limit views: how much a borrow can take now under the RiskModule's speed windows. Immutable. | 0x449995AcFbE7414ac4323aC06c46b65a4074752f |
| LensAaveSizing | Aave V4's liquidation sizing, compiled from the pinned Aave V4 release, used by the liquidation preview. Immutable. | 0x266450a9FE11d34a7A3E5170D6c1799Da6C4A736 |
